issues.source_excerpt:
I2.1.2.2 The ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, of the ship corresponding to the
            upper ice waterline (UIWL). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the
            displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest
            displacement.
issues.reason: The query reports a violation only when a case displacement is greater than DUI. A DUI numerically greater than every represented case displacement therefore passes, although it is not numerically equal to the displacement of the waterline having the greatest displacement. The source requires selection of the greatest displacement, so the constraint must enforce numeric equality with the maximum, using the declared quantity value and metric-kilotonne unit paths.
issues.expected: DUI must be numerically equal, in metric kilotonnes, to the greatest displacement among the waterlines used for determining the UIWL.
issues.suggestion: Replace the one-sided FILTER (?caseValue > ?upperValue) test with a query that rejects DUI unless no represented case has a greater numeric displacement and at least one represented case has numeric displacement equal to DUI, while retaining the supplied quantity paths and unit constraints.

issues.source_excerpt:
Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the
            displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest
            displacement.
issues.reason: The supplied mapping establishes that hasUpperIceWaterlineCase points to upperIceWaterlineCase, but it does not establish that the represented cases are the complete set of waterlines used for determining the UIWL. The candidate therefore cannot be confirmed to select the greatest displacement over the full source-relevant set. This is a material representation-adequacy question distinct from the confirmed one-sided comparison error.
issues.expected: The represented case collection must be established as the complete set of waterlines used for determining the UIWL before the greatest displacement is selected.
issues.suggestion: Provide an explicit supplied completeness convention for hasUpperIceWaterlineCase, or supply a schema-supported path or constraint establishing that the case collection is exhaustive. Do not infer completeness from the RDFS domain or range.
